embeds.title: NMC
embeds.description: National Mobility Command  handles government cargo transport and national logistics. All skins are themed around high-value cargo operations and mission-critical transport.

embeds.title: · Rules  ·
embeds.description:
**Protocol 1 — Behavioral Enforcement**
Worker App scans for instability. Any personnel found disturbing the server environment or engaging in unethical conduct will face immediate correction. It is powered by AI so be careful while talking. 

**Protocol 2 — Asset Security**
Unauthorized distribution of VTC-owned assets(skins, logos) is a critical violation. Detection will trigger severe consequences from both the NMC and Wanda Software.

embeds.title: Worker
embeds.description:
Worker APP handles server economy, moderation and support. Ping him in any channel and he will reply to you. 

As the primary support interface, it is programmed to navigate the database and provide instant answers regarding VTC logistics, game mechanics, and general inquiries.
